<ic>Disbursal of funds to place a ritual developed by the halls of knowledge into Imperial Law: Skeins of Years.<br><br>
''Raised by Morrow, seconded by Bregasland''</ic>

===Overview===
* Request for funds to pay for adding [[Skein of Years]] to [[Formulaic_ritual#Imperial_Lore_and_the_Ritual_List|Imperial Lore]].
* Ritual developed at the [[Provost of the Halls of Knowledge|Halls of Knowledge]].

===Date===
* Summer 378YE

===Progress===
* 10 Thrones disbursed to Senator Morrow

===Outcome===
Adding a ritual to Imperial Lore requires a [[Declaration#Declaration of Imperial Lore|Declaration of Imperial Lore]] from the [[Conclave]]. These funds are intended to pay for the ritual to be added, pending the decision of the Conclave.
